name: ask in tab 1
eval: T.ask('Quelle est la capitale du Japon ? Un mot.'); return true

name: tab 2 sees the answer in progress or done
rename in tab 1
eval: T.btn('…',document.querySelector('.topbar')).click(); await T.sleep(400); T.btn('Renommer',document.querySelector('.menu')).click(); await T.sleep(400); const d=document.querySelector('.dialog'); d.querySelector('input').value='Capitale nippone'; [...d.querySelectorAll('button')].find(b=>b.classList.contains('primary')).click(); await T.sleep(600); return true

name: delete in tab 1
eval: T.btn('…',document.querySelector('.topbar')).click(); await T.sleep(400); T.btn('Supprimer',document.querySelector('.menu')).click(); await T.sleep(400); const d=document.querySelector('.dialog'); if (d) [...d.querySelectorAll('button')].find(b=>b.classList.contains('primary')||/Supprimer/.test(b.innerText)).click(); await T.sleep(800); return true
